newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong Motor shares up on loan news.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong Motor shares up on loan news.

text.p: Shares in Ssangyong Motor Co rose to their daily limit on Wednesday morning on news that the debt-ridden company had recently been approved a 20 billion won loan from its prime creditor bank, brokers said.
Shares in the utility vehicle maker were trading at 5,540 won, up 410 won on the day.
An official at Chohung Bank said on Wednesday the bank's loan screening committee had recently approved the application from Ssangyong.

He also said the bank had supplied another 20 billion won to Ssangyong by purchasing commercial papers issued by the company, which has been struggling under heavy debts after recording losses for several years.
Trading on the stock was quite active with 168,930 shares changing hands by mid-morning.
